name: The Americana at Brand
description: The Americana at Brand is a premier open-air lifestyle destination in Glendale, California, offering a remarkable blend of upscale shopping, diverse dining options, AMC movie theaters, and year-round entertainment. Located just minutes from Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, this Caruso property features luxury retailers, a dancing fountain, regular events including holiday celebrations and Kids Club activities, and premium amenities like Caruso Signature membership, valet parking, and concierge services. The center creates a unique village-like atmosphere that combines high-end retail with entertainment and community gathering spaces.
demographics: The Americana at Brand attracts an affluent, diverse demographic primarily consisting of upper-middle to high-income households with annual incomes exceeding $100,000, drawn from Glendale, Pasadena, and surrounding Los Angeles communities. The visitor base includes young professionals aged 25-44, families with children, and empty nesters who appreciate the center's upscale retail mix, entertainment offerings, and sophisticated ambiance. The trade area encompasses educated, style-conscious consumers who prioritize quality, experiential shopping, and are willing to spend on premium brands, fine dining, and family-friendly activities. Regular visitors tend to be frequent shoppers who combine retail therapy with dining and entertainment, often spending 2-3 hours per visit enjoying the center's resort-like atmosphere and community events.
summary: The Americana at Brand is an upscale open-air lifestyle center in Glendale featuring luxury shopping, dining, entertainment, and a vibrant community atmosphere near Los Angeles and Hollywood.
